wifi_enabled.label: Enable WiFi
wifi_enabled.description: Enable or disable WiFi connectivity. When disabled, device will always start in AP mode for configuration.

wifi_ssid.label: WiFi Network Name
wifi_ssid.description: SSID of the WiFi network to connect to

wifi_timeout.label: WiFi Timeout
wifi_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for WiFi connection attempts

wifi_retries.label: WiFi Retry Count
wifi_retries.description: Number of connection attempts before switching to AP mode

ap_password.label: AP Password
ap_password.description: Password for Access Point mode - leave empty for open network

network_dhcp.label: Use DHCP
network_dhcp.description: Automatically obtain IP address from router

network_ip.label: Static IP Address
network_ip.description: Manual IP address when DHCP is disabled

network_subnet.label: Subnet Mask
network_subnet.description: Network subnet mask for static IP configuration

network_gateway.label: Gateway Address
network_gateway.description: Router IP address for static IP configuration

webserver_port.label: Web Server Port
webserver_port.description: TCP port for the web interface

ajax_timeout.label: AJAX Timeout
ajax_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for web interface API calls

sensor0_pin.label: Sensor Pin
sensor0_pin.description: GPIO pin connected to the DHT22 data line

sensor0_toffset.label: Temperature Offset
sensor0_toffset.description: Temperature calibration offset in degrees Celsius

mosfet_fan_pin.label: Fan Control Pin
mosfet_fan_pin.description: GPIO pin for fan MOSFET control

mosfet_ptc_pin.label: PTC Heater Pin
mosfet_ptc_pin.description: GPIO pin for PTC heater MOSFET control

ambTempTarget.label: Target Temperature
ambTempTarget.description: Desired ambient temperature in degrees Celsius
